records.reason: The text opens «وقال الليث حدثني», without a formula of transmission from al-Bukhari's own shaykh. Dorar's grade line for صحيح البخاري 2819 is «[معلق]». A suspended report is not under the condition of the Sahih (Ibn al-Salah, Muqaddima, type 1, point 6), so the collection grade is not stated of it and the record stays pending. The same hadith is in the corpus with connected chains (bukhari:3424, 5242, 6639, 6720, 7469). Decided 2026-10-03, docs/DECISIONS.md D-5.
